history.summary: Comparison listing surfaced by the condo search, not the evaluation target. 785 sqft 2BR at $1.25M ($1,592 psf) — the cheapest psf of the three Waterfront sisters, TOP 2014 (newest of the three with listings), ~84 years lease, 400m to Bedok Reservoir MRT.
history.rating_rationale: On raw numbers this screens as better value than the Waterfront Key target: ~$147 psf cheaper, two years newer, two more years of lease, and a $228K lower quantum that widens the buyer pool further. URA cache appreciation is lower (5.84%/yr vs 7.33%) and the unit is smaller. Not researched in depth here — rated Neutral pending its own dedicated evaluation, but it is the comp to view alongside the Key unit.
red_flags: Smaller 785 sqft layout limits family-tenant appeal vs the Key unit
Same micro-market exit competition from the other Waterfront sisters
catalysts: Same Bayshore/TEL halo and Bedok Reservoir micro-market scarcity as Waterfront Key

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Compact 2BR near DTL should achieve roughly $3.9-4.3K/mo, implying ~3.8-4.1% gross yield at $1.25M — likely the best yield of the three sisters. Not verified against closed leases.
